set.body: Install the worklog work-tracking scaffold in forge-notes: bin/ helper scripts, git hooks wired via core.hooksPath, .work/ JSONL logs with union merge, the CI workflow, and docs/plans + docs/status. Configure the repo for GitHub Issues as the ticket tracker and the GitHub wiki for docs publishing. bin/ and hooks/ are committed so hooks and CI work for teammates who do not have the plugin installed.
set.title: Scaffold worklog tracking and configure GitHub Issues + wiki

set.body: Enable Better Auth's local email and password provider and build the sign-in/sign-up form on the login route. Social sign-in federates through the shared Grok auth broker, whose preview OAuth client only accepts callbacks on *.grok-sandbox.com, so it cannot complete on a Tauri desktop window or local dev where the origin is loopback. Email and password is the only working desktop sign-in path. Also rebrands the login page to ForgeNotes and regenerates the Tauri icons.
set.title: Email & password sign-in for desktop and localhost

set.resolution: Scaffold installed and configured; wiki published (8 pages), issue #3 synced, merged in PR #2.
Scaffold installed and configured; wiki published (8 pages), issue #3 synced, merged in PR #2.
Merged in PR #1. Code shipped and CI green (tsc + eslint clean on changed files); the runtime path is NOT verified — no sign-up round trip and no Tauri desktop test were run.

set.body: Adopt an agent-runnable UI verification loop for ForgeNotes: a written spec and PlantUML Salt wireframe define intent, the UI is made addressable, and an agent takes a real screenshot of the macOS WKWebView via the Tauri MCP bridge and compares it against the wireframe and a written rubric before calling work done. Covers Vitest, Playwright WebKit, tauri-plugin-mcp-bridge, testability retrofit, screenshot determinism controls, and per-screen specs.
set.title: Agent-runnable UI verification loop

set.body: Force-add CLAUDE.md past the global gitignore so teammates get the guidance, open and merge the pending close-auth-item PR, normalize doc metadata, and file the work items for this effort.
set.title: Phase 0: clear decks — commit CLAUDE.md, close out worklog state

set.body: Install vitest+jsdom and @playwright/test pinned to 1.61.1 (matching the installed chromium rev 1228 that scripts/browser-smoke.mjs depends on). Standalone vitest.config.ts to avoid the throwing pgliteBootstrapPlugin entirely. Install webkit rev 2311. No global setup file: a global mockIPC would make isTauri() always true and hide the web-mode branch.
set.title: Phase 1: Vitest + Playwright WebKit foundation

set.body: Wire tauri-plugin-mcp-bridge as an optional dependency behind a cargo feature, since cfg(debug_assertions) cannot gate a dependency. Verify the default release build still compiles and the crate is absent from its dependency graph. Go/no-go on one webview_screenshot and one webview_dom_snapshot before anything depends on it.
set.title: Phase 2: debug-only Tauri MCP bridge

set.body: Add structural data attributes (data-block-type, data-wizard-step) rather than enumerated testids, aria-labels for the ~20 unnamed icon-only buttons, role/aria-modal on CommandPalette, id/htmlFor on form controls. Hoist the theme effect from AppShell to __root so /login can render dark at all.
set.title: Phase 3: testability retrofit + login dark-mode fix

set.body: A .ui-freeze class seeded from localStorage plus ~8 lines of CSS kills spinners, toasts and animations at once, and works with any capture tool since MCP browser tools have no mask parameter. A sibling .ui-reveal class forces hover-gated affordances visible.
set.title: Phase 4: screenshot determinism and reveal controls

set.body: One markdown per screen family under docs/ui (invisible to the worklog IA, so zero coupling), PlantUML Salt wireframes rendered by two package.json lines. Pilot on the AI Setup Wizard: 7 wireframes, since CredentialsStep branches on isCliBackend into two different screens.
set.title: Phase 5: spec/wireframe/rubric pipeline, piloted on AiSetupWizard

set.body: Six waves of per-screen docs, the AGENTS.md protocol replacing the stale Browser QA section, and the repo's first Node CI workflow.
set.title: Phase 6: roll out to remaining screens, make the loop mandatory

set.resolution: Committed CLAUDE.md past the global ignore, filed the epic and seven stories, normalized doc metadata.
Vitest 4 + jsdom with a standalone config avoiding the throwing pglite plugin, Playwright pinned to 1.61.1, WebKit 2311, 20 unit + 3 e2e, and the repo's first CI job that runs code.

Bridge behind an optional cargo feature (absent from the default dep graph), runtime-registered capability, and a cross-agent port broker. Gate passed: real WKWebView screenshot + accessibility snapshot.
Structural data attributes over enumerated testids, plus two real SSR bugs fixed on /login: dark mode unreachable, and a hydration mismatch. Both shipped in PR #1.
.ui-freeze and .ui-reveal seeded from localStorage, DEV-only, verified by effect-asserting tests and a real desktop screenshot.
docs/ui pipeline plus the AI Setup Wizard pilot: 7 wireframes, rubric template, capture recipe. Running the loop found two wireframe errors.

set.body: Cut v0.2.0, the first tagged release of ForgeNotes. Ships the agent-runnable UI verification loop: Vitest and Playwright WebKit test foundation, a debug-only Tauri MCP bridge with a cross-agent port broker, UI addressability attributes, screenshot determinism controls, the docs/ui spec-wireframe-rubric pipeline piloted on the AI Setup Wizard, and CI gating. Also two SSR bug fixes on /login.
set.title: Release v0.2.0
